integrity: The homotopy equivalence is proved directly from the standard one-step homotopy definition. Finite computations are used only as corroboration and do not replace the proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The forward-endomorphism condition is sufficient rather than necessary. The path-homology corollary is stated only for standard complete independent-fiber blow-ups and, for the explicit cycle computation, for consistently oriented cycles of length at least three.
title: Forward-shift blow-ups preserve digraph homotopy type
